decisions.statement: The reading now is the multiplier the open block is priced at.
The multiplier is read from the gap between the block's safety and difficulty.
A block a full level inside the safety level reads zero rather than no reading.
No open block is no reading rather than a cost of zero.
An open block missing either level is no reading rather than a cost of zero.
A level given as text is read as the number that text spells.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a cost into a color.

definition: what an hour of the block Alan is in costs him
